rationale: The answer is an honest abstention: it reports that the CAPEC specialist returned no records and the shown query was rejected, so it does not guess the expected terms. However, it omits all five expected alternate names for the parent pattern of CAPEC-384 (Man-in-the-Middle / MITM, Monkey-in-the-Middle, Monster-in-the-Middle, On-path Attacker, Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM). It also mentions unsupported example identifiers T1566, M1017, and CAPEC-98, so it is partial rather than fully correct.
